findings.headline: Import the Solid 2 Vite plugin from @solidjs/vite-plugin.
findings.why: vite-plugin-solid 2.x compiles JSX for Solid 1 and peers on solid-js ^1.7.2, so it won't install beside solid-js 2.0.3. It was renamed @solidjs/vite-plugin; 3.0.1 is the Solid 2 release, needs Vite 8 or 9 and Node 22.12 or newer, and still exports the plugin factory as its default.
findings.guidance: Change this import to @solidjs/vite-plugin and swap the package in package.json; migrate makes both edits. solid() with no options keeps working; the options that changed are reported at each call.

findings.headline: Remove the hot option; @solidjs/vite-plugin has none.
findings.why: vite-plugin-solid 2.x took hot to turn off solid-refresh. @solidjs/vite-plugin 3 replaces it with refresh, and its option types reject hot.
findings.guidance: Delete hot. If it was false, set refresh: false instead.

findings.headline: Install @babel/core for this babel option, and check the plugins it adds.
findings.why: @solidjs/vite-plugin 3 compiles JSX with its native compiler and loads @babel/core only for the babel option, as an optional peer it doesn't install. Without it the build fails when the plugin first transforms a file; Babel plugins written against babel-preset-solid's Solid 1 output may also no longer apply.
findings.guidance: Add @babel/core to devDependencies, or drop the option when it only configured JSX. Check each Babel plugin it adds against Solid 2's compiled output.

findings.headline: Set solid.moduleName to "@solidjs/web" or remove it.
findings.why: The compiler imports its runtime helpers from moduleName, and Solid 2 has no solid-js/web module; @solidjs/web is the default.
findings.guidance: Delete the option to take the default, or set it to "@solidjs/web".

findings.headline: Remove solid.omitServerOnlyTemplates; Solid 2's compiler has no such option.
findings.why: @solidjs/compiler, which @solidjs/vite-plugin 3 runs, dropped omitServerOnlyTemplates, and the plugin's option types reject it.

findings.headline: Remove the hot option; @solidjs/vite-plugin has none.
findings.why: vite-plugin-solid 2.x took hot to turn off solid-refresh. @solidjs/vite-plugin 3 replaces it with refresh, and its option types reject hot.
findings.guidance: Delete hot. If it was false, set refresh: false instead.
